region_scene_page.compact: Led Zeppelin, Black Sabbath, AC/DC, Deep Purple, and related bands made guitar repetition, volume, and rhythm-section impact the main event.
region_scene_page.standard: Led Zeppelin, Black Sabbath, AC/DC, Deep Purple, and related bands made guitar repetition, volume, and rhythm-section impact the main event. Led Zeppelin's Black Dog, Deep Purple's Highway Star, AC/DC's T.N.T., and Ted Nugent's Cat Scratch Fever give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Led Zeppelin, Black Sabbath, AC/DC, Deep Purple, and related bands made guitar repetition, volume, and rhythm-section impact the main event. The song usually starts in the guitar body, not the lyric. Led Zeppelin's Black Dog, Deep Purple's Highway Star, AC/DC's T.N.T., and Ted Nugent's Cat Scratch Fever give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
